rundown: 76ers beat Raptors 123-112 at Xfinity Mobile Arena in Philadelphia, PA in front of 20,986. It was level at 60-60 at the half. The 2nd quarter decided it: 76ers won it 36-27. Their win chance dropped as low as 21% along the way.
Leading the way — Raptors: RJ Barrett 31 pts, 14 reb; Immanuel Quickley 6 ast. 76ers: Tyrese Maxey 27 pts, 8 ast; VJ Edgecombe 8 reb.
Where 76ers won it: they shot 52% to 48%, shot 43% from three to 38% and won the boards 41-36.
Against the closing line (Draft Kings): 76ers closed as 7.5-point favorites and covered by 3.5; the total closed at 222.5 and they combined for 235, over by 12.5.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 12, 6:59 PM ET. It had Raptors 43% and 76ers 57%, projecting Raptors 110.7 – 76ers 112.9 (223.6 total, 76ers by 2.2).

Final: Raptors 112 – 76ers 123. Right winner: it had 76ers at 57%.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Raptors came in with a league-average attack and a league-average defense (5-6, 114.5 scored and 111.9 allowed a game over 11 games), worth about 67 and 68 games of evidence. Projected to score 110.7, they scored 112 (+1.3 points, 1% over); projected to allow 112.9, they allowed 123 (+10.1 points, 9% over).

76ers came in with a league-average attack and a 2% stingier than average defense (9-3, 110.2 scored and 109.2 allowed a game over 12 games), worth about 68 and 69 games of evidence. Projected to score 112.9, they scored 123 (+10.1 points, 9% over); projected to allow 110.7, they allowed 112 (+1.3 points, 1% over).

The bigger miss was 76ers' scoring (+10.1 points against projection); both sides outscored their projections, so the game ran hotter than either team's numbers said.

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 235 against 223.6 projected (+11.4), about the 73rd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±18.2).

Margin: 76ers by 11 against 76ers by 2.2 projected, about the 77th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±12).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Market (Line movement signal): 76ers ×1.00, Raptors ×1.02. It favored Raptors, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: Against the market
review.body:
PHI ML (-288) at -288: the algo gave it 70% vs 71% fair (-1.4 pts) — won (+0.3u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 71%). TOR ML (+235) at +235: the algo gave it 30% vs 29% fair (+1.4 pts), THE PICK — lost (-1u); lost to the close (closing fair chance 29%). PHI -7.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 48% vs 50% fair (-2 pts) — won (+0.9u); same number as the close. TOR +7.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 52% vs 50% fair (+2 pts) — lost (-1u); same number as the close. OVER 223.5 (-110) at -110: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (+0 pts) — won (+0.9u); lost to the closing 222.5 by 1. UNDER 223.5 (-109) at -109: the algo gave it 50% vs 50% fair (0 pts) — lost (-1u); beat the closing 222.5 by 1.

From the algo's snapshot to the close: total 223.5 → 222.5. The total moved away from the algo's number.

review.title: Where the public and the money were
review.body:
Splits (Action Network): spread: 34% of bets on Raptors, 36% of the money — 76ers covered; total: 77% of bets on the over, 77% of the money — it went over; moneyline: 6% of bets on Raptors, 4% of the money.

The sharp side by the algo's read was Raptors, who lost and didn't cover.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.042 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +8.9 points. It counts toward NBA scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 64 graded NBA games the algo now scales scoring ×0.992 and gives home teams +0.2 points. Team corrections so far: Raptors attack ×0.984, defense ×1.003 (5 games); 76ers attack ×1.001, defense ×1.012 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Right side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, the pick lost (-1u).
